main_integration_review.scope: Main independently checked vocabulary/page locations, chapter boundaries, source emphasis spot-checks and cue scope/reuse. Original author-pending statements below are chronological draft notes superseded by this review. No clinical, human expert, recall or render validation.
main_integration_review.normalizations: Line-wrap hyphens, beta and punctuation normalized. Chapter23 wet surface expands wet or conducting surface; Chapter25 calcium gluconate expands Calcium chloride or gluconate; blood volume also appears as blood and plasma volume. Shared-word expansions are not contiguous quotations.
main_integration_review.family_collision_warning: Qualify co-occurring family cues such as atrial/ventricular fibrillation, calcium salts or gangrene subtypes; family reuse is not exact subtype discrimination.

source.verification: Author verified purchased-file hash, extracted vocabulary locations and visually inspected full boundary-page rasterizations PDF1 and PDF6. This is author source checking only; independent main audit remains pending. Source matches establish vocabulary locations, not clinical or recall validity.

scope: 48 offline vocabulary entries: 37 retained candidates, 7 reuses and 4 holds after main integration on 2026-10-20. Typography/key-term screen included; not exhaustive concepts, clinical teaching, measured recall or image prompts.

keyword_screen.method: Offline PyMuPDF 1.27.2.3 span/font screen of actual chapter bounds; inspected Bold, Semibold and Black font families and bold flags, lexical nouns/phrases within emphasized body statements, and meaningful table labels. Evidence strings give actual font, point size and source-span bounding box (PDF points); wrapped words/separators normalized only when visibly supported. Full-page raster spot checks PDF2/3/5/6/7/8/10/11, with all 11 page rasters saved locally. No PDF annotations on any assigned page; colored publisher headings/table shading are typography, not user highlights. Unformatted table trials are labeled separately, not falsely called bold. This is not exhaustive extraction of all key medical concepts, a salience ranking, or clinical/recall validation; expanded entries await main's independent keyword audit.

highlight_annotation_check.note: Enumerated all annotation types on PDF1-6: zero annotations of any kind, including highlights.
